summary: Inspected all five files in the work unit. The root module HexBareissTheory.lean is not a pure import aggregator—it states two determinant correctness theorems (bareissDet_eq_det, bareiss_eq_det) in a public section. Bareiss.lean contains the core no-pivot and row-pivoted Bareiss invariant proofs (NonzeroBareissPivots, BareissNoPivotInvariant, BareissPivotInvariant, and their preservation lemmas). Kernel.lean proves soundness of the kernel determinant certificate against Mathlib's Matrix.det (det_eq_of_checkList, det_eq_of_checkRat, and packed variants). Tactic.lean defines the det tactic, det% term elaborator, and hex_norm_det simproc interface with their correctness proofs. Tests.lean holds concrete determinant computations (dense16_det, dense16_det') and named theorems exercising the tactic on all supported literal forms. All files contain formal mathematical definitions, statements, proofs, or interfaces relevant to search.
